environment: local Windows Node.js, isolated PostgreSQL and Redis, deterministic model and Skill fixtures; not a production SLO
rootCause: The single-process Runtime attempted up to 640 canonical projection items plus 32 export partitions per one-second scheduler tick, creating an unfair PostgreSQL and event-loop catch-up burst during business tasks.
repair: Bound canonical projection and export work to eight durable slices per tick; no threshold or assertion was weakened.
